summary:
Accepted .github PR #4544 adds an inert original-App factory bound to the fixed original .103 candidate/checkpoint and selected application identity. Injected inert JWT/opener/clock/retention/admission ports prove effective identity before lexical lease use and retain the exact owned token through consumer or reporting failure. One issuance and revocation are attempted without automatic retry; lost responses remain unknown. These reports are not native durable ACKs or worker-loss custody, and the approved production factory still refuses. PR #4545 delivers a separate protected authentication workflow with an unconditional false job, exact repository/main/actor/attempt fences, contents-read permissions, immutable checkout and refusal-only terminal. Its separate read-only PR/main caller runs thirteen policy rejection groups; no credential ingress is activated.
The domain binding still requires the publisher workflow path, whereas the selected inactive authentication job has a different path. This is a held integration gate, not active credential misrouting. A future closed contract revision must reconcile exact workflow/job/source/run/attempt identity after the execution-site, supervisor-lifetime and trusted-ingress topology is decided; broadening an allowlist or changing a string cannot supply that decision. The publisher's ordinary journal App token targets the separate Authority repository with contents-write and is skipped for authentication-only selection. Its token, GitHub token or NuGet OIDC cannot substitute for original-App identity, original-operation admission or independent same-token custody. An owner-issued App JWT and an independently admitted original-operation descriptor/clock are distinct joins. Protected Coordination exposes already-owned inert streams and refuses native construction; serialized equality, source names or a sentinel cannot establish trusted ingress or installed authority.
Retain the earlier cooperative urllib deadline failure. Native absolute custody, clock conversion, outstanding-task accounting, terminal readback, genuine grant/scope proof and independent same-token revocation after worker loss remain separately unqualified. A lexical finally, hosted job cleanup or token expiry cannot supply them. Retained pre-effect facts and ACKs, first failure, separate issuance/revocation uncertainty and original cutoffs remain binding; no new session clock or budget is created. Original .103 candidate/checkpoint, generation2 attempted-unknown tag effect and frozen nine dependency pins remain unchanged. Accepted inactive source and environment selection authorize no native credential effect, historical settlement, original-tag replay or .104 publication.
title: Isolated authentication source retains the original issuer and custody topology gate
